scope: Local optional active Todo stages; no live tests or deployment

checks.name: Release application and all three Worker dry builds
Stage and mapping combinations in both runtimes
Packaged skill, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Optional Todo-only executionStage survives portable copies, explicit clear, state transitions, completion, exact restoration and native unlinked archival. Missing or cleared stage means Inbox only while active; native state dominates dormant metadata.
Exact stage-only commands preserve order, native state, metadata, dates, dependencies, histories and all game mappings; effects and accepted task activity remain zero.

Invalid enum values, mixed patches, non-Todo/inactive/closed targets, projection requests, stale revisions and snapshot/effect tampering fail. v8 binds exact intent while unused previous hashes and enum values remain unchanged.

Synthetic SDK/browser paths enforce task-write grants and profile ownership, reject altered previews and recover original request/command receipts after acknowledgement loss with zero real upstream writes.
Canonical contracts and packaged planning guidance explain defaults, dormant preferences and separate state/restoration flows without claiming production UI or client qualification.

operations.outcome: An added archival check initially used a linked fixture and correctly failed unsupported_projection. The fixture now uses an unlinked native task; full Worker and focused .NET requalification pass.

limitations: Production board controls, stage filters, actual hosts/devices and live gameplay remain outside the local milestone.
No deployment was needed for local implementation.
